children: Sao Paulo, Sept 11 (Reuters) - Consumer prices as measured by the benchmark IPCA index (BRCPI=ECI), fell 0.32% in August, below market forecasts, government statistics agency IBGE said on Friday.	Prices rose 4.22% in the 12 months through August.	Below is the result for each price category: 	                              August       July      - Food and beverages         -0.34        -0.67     - Housing                    -1.87         0.99      - Household articles          0.64         0.07     - Apparel                     0.12        -0.66     - Transport                  -0.86         0.05     - Health and personal care    0.23         0.40     - Personal expenses           1.30         0.22     - Education                   0.47        -0.03     - Communication              -0.09         0.04
